title: The Blood of Jesus Brings Harvest and Restoration
description: In this powerful sermon from Pastor Chris Zehner, you'll discover how to tap into the game-changing power of prayer and see your family and friends brought back to God. Learn how to break the chains of sin and see your loved ones set free, and how to position yourself for financial breakthrough and the fulfillment of your dreams. As Pastor Chris leads you in a time of intercession and declaration, you'll be equipped to take the promises of God to the streets and see the miracles of the Kingdom manifest in your life.
